sections.heading: Mad Chairs Tournament 2026
paragraphs: The Mad Chairs Tournament 2026 is a competition associated with IEEE SSCI 2027.
The competition is now live on Kaggle. Participants can find the competition details, rules, data, evaluation criteria, and submission instructions on the Kaggle competition page.

cards.title: Join the Competition on Kaggle
cards.text: Visit Kaggle to review the rules and participate in Mad Chairs Tournament 2026.
